findings.issue: Shell injection vulnerability: testCmd from getCommand() is interpolated into execSync template literal.
findings.recommendation: Replace execSync template literal with execFileSync using array arguments.
findings.fix: Replaced execSync with execFileSync using array args, bare script name + PM-aware command construction

findings.issue: {script:X} and {exec:X} template syntax in config.json not implemented at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Revert config values to actual commands.
findings.fix: Replaced all {script:X}/{exec:X} with actual commands (npm run lint, npx tsc, etc.) and null for auto-detect

findings.issue: Script names from package.json used in shell commands without sanitization.
findings.recommendation: Add input validation: reject names containing shell metacharacters.
findings.fix: Added isSafeScriptName() validator with UNSAFE_CHARS regex, applied in getCommand() and getExecParts()

findings.issue: Config and package.json cached with no invalidation strategy.
findings.recommendation: Document caching behavior; each hook invocation is a fresh process.
findings.fix: Added documentation comment explaining cache lifecycle (fresh process per hook invocation)

findings.issue: Uses raw JSON.parse instead of safeJsonParse.
findings.fix: Replaced JSON.parse in getConfig() and getPackageScripts() with safeJsonParse()

findings.issue: getExecParts() split assumption — exec.split(' ') may not produce exactly 2 parts.
findings.recommendation: Add guard for unexpected split result.
findings.fix: Added parts.length !== 2 guard with safe fallback
Added documentation comment explaining cache lifecycle

findings.issue: Duplicate detectPackageManager logic in flow-script-resolver.js and flow-workflow.js.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable — flow-workflow.js detects more than just PM.
findings.fix: Accepted: flow-workflow.js detectProjectType() returns language+framework+PM, not just PM. Different consumers, different return types.

findings.issue: Several exports not imported by any consumer.
findings.fix: Accepted: public API exports for external consumers and testing.
